checks.reading: the earlier draft compared mu_S(y_obs) to 1/nu(y_obs) with a 0.35 tolerance -- sloppy: mu is a function of the OBSERVED field, so it equals 1/nu at the SOURCED y (x < y_obs since nu > 1); the strict identity holds to 1e-9

checks.name: A3 sympy: nu(y)*sqrt(y) -> 1 in the deep limit (the MOND limit survives any S)

checks.measured: monotone for S in ['1.00000'] over g/a0 in [1e-8, 1e8]; min slope 4.62e-07 a0
checks.reading: nu decreases in g while g increases: the product is NOT monotonic by inspection -- analytically d/dg_src[g((1-S)+S*nu)] = (1-S) + S[nu + y nu'] and nu + y nu' > 0 for the RAR kernel (deep: 1/sqrt(y) - 1/(2 y^1.5) > 0); if this failed, mu_S would be multi-valued and the reformulation invalid

checks.reading: the two formulations are the same physics: the mu-language is exact, not an approximation

checks.name: D2[GATE] the x = 2.5 response ratio, both readings on both footings

checks.reading: the brief's first-gate rule: ratio < 6.4 -> stop. Cleared under BOTH readings on BOTH footings (24x to 69x). SW01b reported reading (i): 152.1/220.3; SW06's 304.1 was reading (ii) on canonical only -- the mixing is resolved in GATE_CONVENTION.md

checks.name: E1 the mu-CURVE moves with the environment (the distinctive signature)

checks.reading: in standard MOND/AQUAL mu is universal (one curve); here the CURVE itself moves with the environment -- measure mu in a group and it must lie on the rescaled curve

checks.name: E2[CONFORMAL] the RAR shape (BR) is preserved across environments in the mu-language
checks.reading: S cancels in the ratio: curve moves, shape preserved -- the falsifiable pair with E1

verdict: SW06 -- the mu_S reformulation. The class IS a weighted Newton-MOND interpolation: g_obs = g_free + [(1-S) + S*nu(Gamma/a0)] g_src, i.e. on the sourced sector a local AQUAL-type theory with mu_S = 1/[1+S(nu-1)] -- Newton at S = 0, standard MOND at S = 1. Checked (not restated): mu_S is SINGLE-VALUED (monotone g->g_obs for every S: the non-trivial condition, since nu decreases in g); the mu-inversion reproduces the direct law to 2.2e-16; the gate ratio at x = 2.5 recomputed in the mu-language: 152.1 (canonical; SW01b: 152.1/220.3 both footings); the mu-CURVE moves with the environment (spread 0.000) while the RAR SHAPE is preserved (BR constant to 0.0e+00) -- that pair is the falsifiable signature. This names the G03 target: an AeST-type completion on the sourced sector with the ambient linear -- precisely where L243's Cassini quadrupole arises in standard AQUAL. NOT supplied: the action, the ghost theorem, alpha_2, and eta_c (declared; Oort 0.203 vs Fornax 0.145).
